description: Source code for the main notes management interface in a Qwik-based frontend application. Implements note creation, editing, deletion, and searching with reactive state management and local storage persistence.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Helper function to generate unique IDs based on random string and timestamp.

methods.name: selectNote
methods.description: Sets the current selected note ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with default values, adds it to the list, and selects it.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Removes a note by ID from the list and updates selection if needed.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Updates the currently selected note's title, content, and updated timestamp based on user input.

methods.name: filteredNotes
methods.description: Computes and returns the filtered list of notes based on current search query.
